Identify all plausible TV shows that match the following clues and compile a structured shortlist with citations: (a) show premise features undercover characters using martial arts and technology to protect people from an evil character; (b) original airing years fall between 2005 and 2012; (c) total episode count remained under 30 as of 2023; (d) produced by a company founded in the 1900s; (e) the producer company faced a resource shortage issue in or by 2023 due to suppliers shutting down; (f) the show had an official web game available as of 2016. For each candidate, provide: title, country/region, years aired, total episode count (with source), premise summary, key villain(s), production company (and founding year with citation), any evidence of 2023 supplier-shutdown-related resource shortage for that company (with citation), evidence of a web game circa 2016 (archived page or news with citation), and a brief reliability/fit assessment. Include at least 6 candidates even if some partially match; clearly note mismatches or uncertainties. Also collect early leads to theme song information (official opening video links or lyrics sources) for each candidate where available.

State a clear counting rule for “third line” (e.g., distinct sung lines separated by pauses/line breaks; treat repeated chants/shouts as separate lines only if musically separated). Identify the third line under this rule. Note any differences between versions (UK/US/Teletoon) that may change line order. Provide URLs/citations and screenshots/timecodes where relevant. Also check if any official lyric publication exists (press kits, soundtrack listings, subtitles/closed captions). As a cross-check, verify whether the following candidates have lyrical themes: Sym-Bionic Titan (2010–2011), ThunderCats (2011), Human Target (2010), The Cape (2011), Samurai Girl (2008), Guyver: The Bioboosted Armor (2005). If instrumental or non-lyrical, note that. Summarize uncertainties and provide all plausible third-line candidates if versions differ.
